title: Value-level data provenance in an electronic laboratory notebook used by humans and language-model agents: An experience report
abstract: arXiv:2610.27859v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A published laboratory number can be verified only when its raw file and extraction method are known. This paper presents the value-level provenance architecture of APS ELN, an electronic laboratory notebook used by both researchers and language-model agents. The architecture was motivated by a production audit in a materials laboratory covering projects performed over almost 5 years. Tracing eight baseline studies from sample to stored value showed that the initial ELN structure preserved the link from sample to raw file. Still, the link from raw file to stored value was lost, mainly due to human factors: manual entries carried no file reference or extractor version. To close this gap, the database design and workflow were reworked so that every stored value records its source file, the data file reader/viewer (DFR) plugin and version, any interactive analysis selection, or the server-side formula for derived quantities. tldr: 本文报告了电子实验笔记本APS ELN的值级数据溯源架构经验：针对近5年审计中发现的“从原始文件到存储数值”关联丢失问题，通过重构数据库和工作流程，使每个存储数值都记录其源文件、提取插件版本及派生公式，从而实现数值的可验证性。
en_tdlr: This experience report presents the value-level data provenance architecture of APS ELN, where database and workflow redesigns ensure every stored value records its source file, extraction plugin version, and derivation formula, closing the traceability gap between raw files and stored values.
